comment:
* LockSettingsService local system service interface.
 *
 * @hide Only for use within the system server.

methods.name: public abstract void onThirdPartyAppsStarted()
methods.comment:
* This is called when Weaver is guaranteed to be available (if the device supports Weaver).
     * It does any synthetic password related work that was delayed from earlier in the boot.

methods.name: public abstract void createNewUser(@UserIdInt int userId, int userSerialNumber)
methods.comment:
* Creates the locksettings state for a new user. *

* This includes creating a synthetic password and protecting it with an empty LSKF. * * @param userId the ID of the new user * @param userSerialNumber the serial number of the new user

methods.name: public abstract void removeUser(@UserIdInt int userId)
methods.comment:
* Removes the locksettings state for the given user. *

* This includes removing the user's synthetic password and any protectors that are protecting * it. * * @param userId the ID of the user being removed

methods.name: public abstract long addEscrowToken(byte[] token, int userId, LockPatternUtils.EscrowTokenStateChangeCallback callback)
methods.comment:
* Create an escrow token for the current user, which can later be used to unlock FBE
     * or change user password.
     *
     * After adding, if the user currently has lockscreen password, they will need to perform a
     * confirm credential operation in order to activate the token for future use.
     * Once the token is activated, the callback that is passed here is called.   If the user
     * has no secure lockscreen, then the token is activated immediately.
     *
     * @return a unique 64-bit token handle which is needed to refer to this token later.

methods.name: public abstract boolean removeEscrowToken(long handle, int userId)
methods.comment:
* Remove an escrow token.
     *
     * @return true if the given handle refers to a valid token previously returned from
     * {@link #addEscrowToken}, whether it's active or not. return false otherwise.

methods.name: public abstract boolean isEscrowTokenActive(long handle, int userId)
methods.comment:
* Check if the given escrow token is active or not. Only active token can be used to call
     * {@link #setLockCredentialWithToken} and {@link #unlockUserWithToken}

methods.name: public abstract boolean setLockCredentialWithToken(LockscreenCredential credential, long tokenHandle, byte[] token, int userId)
methods.comment:
* Set the lock credential.
     *
     * @return true if password is set.

methods.name: public abstract boolean unlockUserWithToken(long tokenHandle, byte[] token, int userId)
public abstract PasswordMetrics getUserPasswordMetrics(int userHandle)
methods.comment:
* Returns PasswordMetrics object corresponding to the given user's lockscreen password.
     * If the user has a password but its metrics isn't known yet (for example if the device
     * has not been unlocked since boot), this method will return {@code null}.
     * If the user has no password, a default PasswordMetrics (PASSWORD_QUALITY_UNSPECIFIED)
     * will be returned.
     *
     * Calling this method on a managed profile user with unified challenge is undefined.
     *
     * @param userHandle the user for whom to provide metrics.
     * @return the user password metrics.

methods.name: public abstract boolean prepareRebootEscrow()
methods.comment:
* Prepare for reboot escrow. This triggers the strong auth to be required. After the escrow
     * is complete as indicated by calling to the listener registered with {@link
     * #setRebootEscrowListener}, then {@link #armRebootEscrow()} should be called before
     * rebooting to apply the update.

methods.name: public abstract void setRebootEscrowListener(RebootEscrowListener listener)
methods.comment:
* Registers a listener for when the RebootEscrow HAL has stored its data needed for rebooting
     * for an OTA.
     *
     * @see RebootEscrowListener
     * @param listener

methods.name: public abstract boolean clearRebootEscrow()
methods.comment: * Requests that any data needed for rebooting is cleared from the RebootEscrow HAL.

methods.name: public abstract int armRebootEscrow()
methods.comment:
* Should be called immediately before rebooting for an update. This depends on {@link
     * #prepareRebootEscrow()} having been called and the escrow completing.
     *
     * @return ARM_ERROR_NONE if the arming worked

methods.name: public abstract void refreshStrongAuthTimeout(int userId)
methods.comment: * Refreshes pending strong auth timeout with the latest admin requirement set by device policy.

methods.name: public abstract void registerLockSettingsStateListener(LockSettingsStateListener listener)
methods.comment:
* Register a LockSettingsStateListener
     * @param listener The listener to be registered

methods.name: public abstract void unregisterLockSettingsStateListener(LockSettingsStateListener listener)
methods.comment:
* Unregister a LockSettingsStateListener
     * @param listener The listener to be unregistered

public abstract boolean setLockCredentialWithToken(LockscreenCredential credential, long tokenHandle, byte[] token, int userId)
